summary: st conversations send/reply --attach renders an SVG to PNG, converts a BMP and scales an image over 10 MiB to fit; the st skill and --attach --help say when an image helps and how to mark up a screenshot

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild; the change is in the CLI before upload.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, retention and admission are unchanged; the daemon still accepts only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP up to 10 MiB.

compatibility.detail: CLI behaviour: --attach and st blobs put without --media-type now accept SVG and BMP (sent as PNG) and still images over 10 MiB up to 256 MiB (scaled to fit), print a line when a file was changed, and refuse HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, PDF and an oversized GIF with a conversion hint. An SVG may draw images only from data: URLs or files inside its own folder. st blobs put --media-type still uploads exact bytes. No wire, client or harness contract change; older daemons accept the prepared uploads.

manual.detail: No manual step. Installed seat skills refresh from the bundled SKILL.md as before.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; rolling back the binary restores the previous --attach behaviour.
